name: native-build-descendants
goal: The simulator build leaves no process behind: what xcodebuild starts and abandons is followed and ended by verified identity, and shared Interface Builder daemons in use by another build are left alone.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Observed in an isolated copy with names: xcodebuild leaves 4 ibtoold (2 from actool, 2 from ibtool), reparented to launchd, own groups, alive 2-3 min. They are shared: a later ibtool reused one. Expected: none left.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/ios-build-processes.test.ts (sha256 9c196712d6721291), real build script under runIsolated with a stand-in xcodebuild: 3 failed, 1 control passed; survivors held 1 process. /tmp/harness-native-processes-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: scripts/ios-build-processes.ts (new): followed() uses the runner's processDescendants/signalProcesses; waits while a foreign ibtool/actool runs. build-ios-simulator.ts awaits it; ios-products.ts shares succeeded().

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged test: 4 passed (/tmp/harness-native-processes-green.log). Real Debug and Release under runIsolated, isolated copy, fresh DerivedData: passed, exit 0, survivors 0; no ibtoold left. Fixture refusal exit 2.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
